card.name: Latin corpus in anatomical terms
card.fires_on: The start of the Latin word corpus (cor-) inside a parenthetical Latin name for a body structure, such as pineal body or geniculate body. It weakly fires on other word-starting fragments like cor-, c-, incor-.

modes.label: Latin corpus in anatomy
modes.description: The cor- start of corpus in the Latin name given in brackets after an English structure called a body.

modes.label: Other word-start fragments
modes.description: Weaker firing on short word-starts such as c-, incor-, Cor- or the start of drug names.
